1441990.sourceDescription:
## Features
- IP65 waterproof LED string lights
- Connectable upto 100m length
- Warm and cool long-life LEDs

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long-lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

1442190.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Warm/Cool White LED Icicle Lights
- Black or White Durable Rubber Cable
- Connectable Up to 50m Coverage

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

## Features
- 720 warm, energy efficient LEDs
- Easy to site with a generous lead
- 8 hour on  16 hour off timer function

- indoor and temporary outdoor use
- SupaBrights by Premier
- On a green cable wire
- IP20 rated transformer
- Non-replaceable, ECO friendly LEDs
- 8 m lead from plug to first bulb for flexible placement away from power sockets.

## Information
Illuminate your tree or display this Christmas with these Decorations. 720 warm , energy efficient LEDs are spaced apart on a cable, making them perfect for placing in most Christmas settings. Easy to site with a generous lead from the plug to the first bulb. Change the Function by short pressing the button on the transformer with available light sequences static, combination, waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing-flash, slow fade and twinkle flash. Long press the same button to activate the 8 hour on 16 hour off timer Function, timer is active when the button lights. Includes a built memory chip which enables the lights to remember the previous setting. Suitable for both indoor and temporary outdoor use, IP20 rated transformer must be kept dry at all times.

8690790.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Made with durable rubber cables
- Versatile Indoor  Outdoor Use
- Customizable Length

## Information
Manufactured with durable rubber cables, these lights are built to withstand the elements, making them a top choice for all-season use. From warm summer evenings to chilly winter nights, these LED String Lights will keep your outdoor space bright and beautiful year-round. Transform your outdoor setting with these versatile and weather-resistant lights and illuminate any occasion with style and ease. And don't worry if you want to bring the magic indoors these lights are versatile enough for prolonged indoor use too. So go ahead and let your creativity shine with these versatile and reliable LED String Lights from Eagle Connect. With the ability to add more connectable lights to an existing starter cable, you can easily customize the length to fit your needs. The lights come in multiples of 5m and 10m lengths, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any room or occasion. Whether you need a few extra meters for a specific area or want to extend your lighting throughout a larger space, our Eagle Connect system has you covered. Order the total length you require, and we will provide you with the appropriate combination of 5m and 10m lengths to get the job done. Featuring high-quality, long-life LED bulbs, our lights are not only energy efficient but also durable. Choose from Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to create a magical ambiance for any occasion. With our Eagle Connect light systems, you can easily transform any space into a beautifully illuminated environment, the possibilities are endless.
